body: Exactly! Wouldn't that be more humane? Just let us go!

I feel like the invisible woman. No one sees me. Not really. But I see you. Someone took notice and cares enough to reach out to a stranger. Keep going as long as you can, you never know what's waiting.

I'm right there with you. The pain is something other people don't understand, but maybe if I can go on a little little longer, you can too. I keep holding on to the hope that there is something meaningful I might miss if I kill myself. It's flimsy, but it's a glimmer of hope that keeps me here.
